entries.name: Inverted Row
entries.reason: Source-bound draft: figure under hip-height rack bar, face up, hands fixed on the bar for the whole cycle; heels planted on the floor; ankle, knee, hip and shoulder in one rigid plank throughout; elbows lead and travel back past the trunk; chest reaches the bar at the top; return to fully long arms. Independent technique and native runtime acceptance required. Not a generic row alias.
entries.summary: Pull your chest to the bar leading with the elbows, keeping the body rigid.

frames.caption: Get under the hip-height bar with heels planted and body in one rigid plank.
Pull your chest to the bar, leading with the elbows, glutes squeezed and body rigid.
Hold chest to bar at the top, touching the same spot.
Lower under control without letting the hips sag.
Return to fully long arms with the plank held rigid.

entries.name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
entries.reason: Source-bound draft from a 3D model turned 18 degrees: holding one dumbbell with both palms against the underside and sweeping it in an arc behind the head and back over the chest.
entries.summary: Lying perpendicular across a flat bench with only the shoulders on the surface, hips low, and feet flat on the floor, hold one dumbbell over the chest with both palms against the underside and a fixed bend in the elbows, lower it in an arc behind the head, and return along the same arc.

frames.caption: Lie perpendicular across a flat bench with only the shoulders on the surface, hips low, feet flat on the floor, and one dumbbell over the chest with the elbows bent.
Keeping that elbow bend fixed, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind the head until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Own the stretch behind the head while holding the same elbow bend and keeping only the shoulders on the bench.
Return the dumbbell along the same arc back over the chest.
Finish over the chest with the elbow bend unchanged.

entries.name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
entries.reason: Source-bound draft from a 3D model turned 18 degrees: holding one dumbbell with both palms against the underside at full extension, lowering in a wide arc behind the head, and returning along the same arc.
entries.summary: Lying perpendicular across a flat bench with only the shoulders on the surface, hips low, and feet flat on the floor, hold one dumbbell over the chest at full extension with both palms against the underside, lower it in a wide arc behind the head with straight arms, and return along the same arc.

frames.caption: Lie perpendicular across a flat bench with only the shoulders on the surface, hips low, feet flat on the floor, and one dumbbell held over the chest at full extension.
Keeping the arms straight, lower the dumbbell in a wide arc behind the head until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Reach long behind the head with the elbows straight and only the shoulders on the bench.
Return the dumbbell along the same wide arc back to the start.
Finish over the chest with the arms straight.

entries.name: Bent-Arm Barbell Pullover
entries.reason: Source-bound draft from a 3D model turned 18 degrees: keeping the elbow bend fixed while lowering the bar in an arc behind the head, pulling back along the same arc, and pausing over the chest.
entries.summary: Lying along a flat bench holding a barbell with a shoulder-width grip over the chest and a fixed bend in the elbows, lower the bar in an arc behind the head until you feel a stretch across the chest, then pull the bar back along the same arc and pause over the chest.

frames.caption: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell with a shoulder-width grip over the chest and the elbows bent.
Keeping the same bend in the elbows, lower the bar in a smooth arc behind the head until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Pull the bar back along the same arc to the start over the chest with the ribs down.
Pause over the chest with the elbow bend fixed.
Hold control over the chest before the next repetition.
